_comment: The portfolio shares the kgwari-dev account (269608740515) rather than
owning one: it is a showcase, not the product, and the dev.kgwari.com zone
already lives there — so the record needs no delegation of its own.
No region keys: the region is decided in
certificate is created by CDK in us-east-1, where CloudFront requires it.
Both used to be pasted here, and a pasted ARN is how a certificate for the
wrong region survives a move unnoticed until deploy.
